facts.fact: Implementation guidelines of the 2025 Kenya Cloud Policy, published by the Ministry of ICT and the Digital Economy, require top secret State data to be held in a data centre within Kenya and bar State entities from hosting data in their own server rooms without Cloud Adoption Committee authorisation, with 24 months to migrate; date is the article's published date.

systems.owner: Ministry of ICT and the Digital Economy
Ministry of ICT and the Digital Economy

note: Cloud Adoption Committee is described as soon to be established, so no enforcer fact recorded.
